# Front

> > Front is a customer operations platform that centralizes team communication across email, SMS, chat, and social channels with AI-powered workflows and collaboration tools.

Front helps customer-facing teams deliver exceptional service through a shared inbox that integrates with Slack, Salesforce, and other tools. The platform combines AI capabilities like Copilot Compose with workflow automation, knowledge management, and analytics to reduce context switching and improve team productivity.

## Key Topics

- Customer support operations
- Workflow automation
- Knowledge management and self-service
- AI-powered customer service (Front AI, Copilot Compose)
- Context switching and productivity
- Customer experience (CX) and satisfaction metrics (CSAT, NPS)
- Support operations and scaling
- Response time and time-to-resolution
- Integrations (Slack, Salesforce, Zoom, Notion)
- Customer communication strategies
- Support-product feedback loops
- Internal quality scorecards
- Shared inbox and channel consolidation
